title: Literary Periods
intro: UP PGT English (Literature) — Literary Periods: Renaissance se Modern tak. Har period ke features, mukhya writers aur key works.

study.en: Rebirth of learning (Greek & Roman classics). Reformation began in 1517 (Luther). Elizabethan Age (1558-1603) gave Shakespeare, Spenser, Marlowe, Sidney. Metaphysical poets (John Donne) used 'conceit'. Key works: The Faerie Queene (Spenser), Hamlet (Shakespeare), Paradise Lost (Milton, 1667).
study.hi: Punarjagran ka daur — yunan-Roman classics ka dobara janm; Reformation 1517 (Luther). Elizabethan Age (1558-1603) — Shakespeare, Spenser, Marlowe, Sidney. Metaphysical poets (John Donne) 'conceit' ke liye mashhoor. Key works: The Faerie Queene, Hamlet, Paradise Lost (1667). Milton = Puritan.

study.en: Monarchy restored in 1660 (Charles II) — hence the name. 'Comedy of Manners' flourished (Congreve, Wycherley). John Dryden was the greatest name (satire, heroic couplet). John Bunyan wrote The Pilgrim's Progress (1678).
study.hi: 1660 me Charles II ki wapasi (monarchy restored) — isliye 'Restoration'. Comedy of Manners ka daur. Dryden sabse bada naam (satire, heroic couplet). John Bunyan — The Pilgrim's Progress (1678).

study.en: Age of Reason / Augustan Age — emphasis on reason, order, wit. Alexander Pope: The Rape of the Lock, An Essay on Criticism. Jonathan Swift: Gulliver's Travels (1726). Addison & Steele: The Spectator. Samuel Johnson: A Dictionary of the English Language (1755).
study.hi: Reason, order aur wit par zor (Age of Reason / Augustan Age). Pope — The Rape of the Lock. Swift — Gulliver's Travels (1726). Addison & Steele — The Spectator. Dr. Johnson — Dictionary (1755).

study.en: Began with Lyrical Ballads (1798) by Wordsworth & Coleridge. Themes: imagination, nature, emotion, common language. Poets: Wordsworth, Coleridge, Byron, Shelley, Keats. Essayists: Charles Lamb, Hazlitt, De Quincey. Novelists: Jane Austen, Sir Walter Scott.
study.hi: 1798 me Wordsworth & Coleridge ki Lyrical Ballads se shuruaat. Imagination, nature, emotion, aam bhasha par zor. Poets: Wordsworth, Coleridge, Byron, Shelley, Keats. Essayists: Charles Lamb, Hazlitt, De Quincey. Novelists: Jane Austen, Walter Scott.

study.en: Named after Queen Victoria (1837-1901). Moral earnestness, industrialisation, and religious doubt (Darwin's Origin of Species, 1859). Poets: Tennyson (In Memoriam), Browning, Matthew Arnold. Novelists: Dickens, Thackeray, George Eliot, Hardy, the Brontës.
study.hi: Queen Victoria (1837-1901) ke naam par. Moral earnestness + industrialisation + doubt (Darwin 1859). Poets: Tennyson (In Memoriam), Browning, Arnold. Novelists: Dickens, Thackeray, George Eliot, Hardy, Brontë sisters.

study.en: Break with tradition; experiment with symbolism and stream of consciousness. T.S. Eliot: The Waste Land (1922). W.B. Yeats, James Joyce (Ulysses), Virginia Woolf, D.H. Lawrence, E.M. Forster.
study.hi: Parampara se toot; symbolism aur stream of consciousness ke experiments. T.S. Eliot — The Waste Land (1922). Yeats, James Joyce (Ulysses), Virginia Woolf, D.H. Lawrence, E.M. Forster.

mcqs.q: Lyrical Ballads (1798) kisne likhi?
mcqs.e: Lyrical Ballads (1798) se Romantic age ki shuruaat maani jaati hai.

mcqs.q: The Faerie Queene ke writer kaun hain?
mcqs.e: The Faerie Queene — Edmund Spenser (Elizabethan age).

mcqs.q: Restoration period ka sabse bada poet/critic?
mcqs.e: John Dryden — Restoration period ka mukhya naam.

mcqs.q: Gulliver's Travels kisne likhi?
mcqs.e: Jonathan Swift — Gulliver's Travels (1726), satire ka master.

mcqs.q: A Dictionary of the English Language (1755) kiski hai?
mcqs.e: Samuel (Dr.) Johnson — 1755 ki Dictionary.

mcqs.q: 'Metaphysical Poetry' ka mukhya naam kaun hai?
mcqs.e: John Donne — metaphysical poetry aur 'conceit' ke liye mashhoor.

mcqs.q: In Memoriam kisne likhi?
mcqs.e: Alfred Tennyson — In Memoriam (Victorian period).

mcqs.q: The Waste Land (1922) kiski rachna hai?
mcqs.e: T.S. Eliot — The Waste Land (1922), modern poetry ka landmark.

mcqs.q: Pride and Prejudice ki lekhika kaun hain?
mcqs.e: Jane Austen — Romantic period ki novelist.

mcqs.q: Paradise Lost kisne likhi?
mcqs.e: John Milton — Paradise Lost (1667), Puritan.

mcqs.q: 'Comedy of Manners' kis period se juda hai?
mcqs.e: Restoration period — Comedy of Manners.

mcqs.q: Reformation ki shuruaat kis saal maani jaati hai?
mcqs.e: 1517 — Luther ke saath Reformation ki shuruaat.

mcqs.q: 'Augustan Age' kis period ka doosra naam hai?
mcqs.e: Neo-classical period ko Augustan Age / Age of Reason bhi kehte hain.

mcqs.q: Ulysses (novel) kisne likha?
mcqs.e: James Joyce — Ulysses (Modern period).

mcqs.q: The Pilgrim's Progress kisne likha?
mcqs.e: John Bunyan — The Pilgrim's Progress (1678), Restoration.

mcqs.q: Queen Victoria ka shasan-kaal kya tha?
mcqs.e: 1837-1901 — Victorian period ka naam inhi se.

mcqs.q: Elizabethan Age ke dauran kaunse poet the?
mcqs.e: Shakespeare aur Spenser — Elizabethan Age (1558-1603).

mcqs.q: The Rape of the Lock kisne likhi?
mcqs.e: Alexander Pope — The Rape of the Lock (Neo-classical).

mcqs.q: Darwin ki 'Origin of Species' kis saal aayi?
mcqs.e: 1859 — Victorian doubt/faith ke tension ka karan.

mcqs.q: Charles Lamb kaun the?
mcqs.e: Charles Lamb — Romantic period ke essayist.

mcqs.q: Heroic couplet kis period ki khaas pehchaan hai?
mcqs.e: Restoration aur Neo-classical period me heroic couplet ka zor.

mcqs.q: Stream of consciousness kis period ki technique hai?
mcqs.e: Modern period — stream of consciousness (Joyce, Woolf).

mcqs.q: Matthew Arnold kaun the?
mcqs.e: Matthew Arnold — Victorian poet aur critic.

mcqs.q: The Spectator kisne nikala?
mcqs.e: Addison & Steele — The Spectator (periodical essays).

mcqs.q: P.B. Shelley kaunse period ke poet hain?
mcqs.e: Shelley — Romantic period ke poet.

mcqs.q: George Eliot kaun hain?
mcqs.e: George Eliot — Victorian novelist.

mcqs.q: W.B. Yeats kaunse period se juda hai?
mcqs.e: W.B. Yeats — Modern period.

mcqs.q: Milton ko kis naam se jaana jaata hai?
mcqs.e: Milton — Puritan poet (Paradise Lost).

mcqs.q: Jane Austen kis period ki novelist hain?
mcqs.e: Jane Austen — Romantic period ki novelist.

mcqs.q: 'Conceit' kis type ki poetry ki khaas cheez hai?
mcqs.e: Metaphysical poetry — 'conceit' (achanak/naqli tulna).
